presentation.question: Can delayed free typing reuse a different phrase-family member?
presentation.opening: Build one Clew Bay farraige line, walk the bay, then type a different question that still keeps the lexeme.
presentation.evidenceLimit: Internal D30 fixture. No historical claims, no county gold, no teaching claims until pedagogue and native audio QA.
presentation.sourceDetail: content/mayo/phrase-families/farraige.v1.json — sibling fixture; does not mutate D29 or B.
presentation.tegCanDo: Fixture capabilities only — not an awarded qualification.

targetWords.anchor: Clew Bay as a maritime world
The fleet that works the sea

pages.title: Keep farraige
pages.body: Place farraige in a Clew Bay location line. A different surround returns later without tiles.
pages.detail: D30 pattern C — encounter before delay.

exercise.objective: Produce the location line with farraige before a delayed reuse of a different family member.
exercise.feedback: The location line holds — farraige sits on this coast.
exercise.hint: Keep the location frame Tá an … anseo, with farraige lenited after an.
exercise.recovery: Build Tá an fharraige anseo — location on Clew Bay.

pages.title: The bay holds the question
pages.body: Between the islands the water opens as bá — the bay that shelters the coast. Farraige is still the open sea beyond. When you ask where it is, the same lexeme returns in a new surround.

pages.title: Type the question
pages.body: No tiles. Ask where the sea is — a different farraige surround after the bay.

exercise.objective: Retrieve a different farraige family member after intervening bay narrative — unsupported typing.
exercise.feedback: Same lexeme, later surround — the question points to the open water.
exercise.hint: Cá bhfuil … ? with an fharraige — fada on Cá, lenition after an.
exercise.recovery: You built the location line earlier. Ask Cá bhfuil an fharraige? — question, not Tá an … anseo.
